displayPattern: Dual 7-segment display: 10 (alternates with the fault that caused it)
meaning: One-hour lockout, caused by repeated failed ignition (11), water sensed (59), dead blower (61), internal fault (93), flame lost 5 times (13) or unexpected flame (14).
causes: See the code shown alternately with 10
diySteps: Read the second code that alternates with 10 and follow that code
Lockout clears when the cause is corrected and power is cycled off and on
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if the furnace keeps entering lockout.
